name: Kawashima Yuuka
source:
Birthday: August 3, 1998 (Leo)
Birthstone: Peridot
Likes: Miniskirts, family, alcohol
Dislikes: Fermented soybeans
Special Skills: Pictures, sports, heavy drinking, making murderous cooking
Family: Mother, father, younger brother, grandfather, grandmother, great-grandfather (lives away)

An upcoming junior who goes to the same college as [url=/c11470]Makoto[/url]. She serves as the group leader in the current Seminar Lodge, given that her cheerful and optimistic attitude makes her an ideal choice. Despite her friendly and outgoing personality, her tendency to wander around drunk has tainted her reputation, along with her disastrous cooking. Still, she's quite easy to get along with thanks to her kindness and good social skills.

[spoiler]In middle school, she met her first love, [url=/c150090]a male classmate[/url] whom she had never confessed her feelings for. Even five years after his death, she still mourns his death and can't break free of those bitter memories she has for him. She tries her best to hide these emotions from others, but after meeting Makoto at the camp and discovering how his speech and conduct resembles the boy's, her feelings become conflicted.[/spoiler]

(From PSP TIPS)
